title: Design Patterns & SOLID
intro: Design patterns interview questions test whether you can apply the Gang-of-Four classics to real Java code — Singleton (and why it is a smell), Factory and Abstract Factory, Builder (with the Java records angle), Strategy, Observer, Decorator, Adapter, Proxy, and the patterns Spring itself uses (Template Method, IoC, AOP). Each answer leads with the problem the pattern solves, the Java implementation, and the trade-offs (when not to use it).
